title: Taskmistress Krisz
summary: Challenge Riwwi's taskmistress and survive sharply increasing melee pressure near the end.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: With at least 18 raid members in the zone, tell Pixtt Kekken 'dare' while the encounter trigger is available.
Krisz strengthens her melee attacks at 40%, 30%, 20%, 10% and 5% health; healing above the corresponding recovery thresholds reverses those increases.
Her 20-minute despawn timer pauses in combat and resumes when combat ends.

notes: Approval E278. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
The initial audit described prerequisite Pixtt kills; the current trigger is dialogue with Pixtt Kekken and an 18-member raid check.
